Updated memory and patched the Treasury Bulletin yields skill.

Key generalizable lesson saved: for historical expected shortfall on Treasury Bulletin yield percentage values, first convert the printed yield levels into consecutive historical returns using Δy / y_prev * 100, then take the lower-tail return(s). For 95% ES with only 9 returns, that effectively means the single worst return, preserving the negative sign and percent unit.
